title: Check complementary slackness numerically
heading: Complementary Slackness: Slack Rows Have Price Zero, Used Variables Have Reduced Cost Zero
cases: the optimal plan with its prices has no violation, and plans that leave a priced row slack or use an activity with a nonzero reduced cost are flagged
slack, prices, values and reduced costs within the tolerance count as zero
a >= row's slack is how far the plan is above the minimum
a reduced cost subtracts the prices of every row the activity is in, >= rows included
